title: Telegraph Office

reward.description: A clicking brass key on a walnut base. Tap it and somewhere, far away, a bell rings.

hints: Loop over the letters of the text. Look each letter up with MORSE[letter].
Words are separated by ' / '. Try signal.split(' / ') to get the words, then .split() each word into codes.
To go backward you need a reversed dictionary. Build one with a loop: for letter, code in MORSE.items(): ...
